nodes.summary: Adjacency in the face graph of the walk is the absence of a walk step on the common side of two cells.
nodes.title: Face-graph adjacency as absence of a walk step between cells

nodes.summary: The ray-parity interior of the walk coincides with the union of bounded face components.
nodes.title: Ray-parity interior equals the bounded face components

nodes.summary: A simple closed walk without right turns whose interior is pinch-free with Euler characteristic `1` has four left turns.
nodes.title: Four left turns from a pinch-free interior of Euler characteristic 1

nodes.summary: The corner defect of the interior equals `±cc d`, the sign given by the orientation of the walk.
nodes.title: Corner defect of the interior is the number of left turns up to sign

nodes.summary: For a simple closed walk, the corner defect of the interior is the sum of the corner weights at the walk vertices.
nodes.title: Corner defect of the interior as a sum over walk vertices

nodes.summary: The corner weight of the interior at the vertex after step `i` is `±1` (sign given by the orientation) at a left turn and `0` at a straight step.
nodes.title: Corner weights at the turns of a walk without right turns

nodes.summary: A lattice point off the walk has corner weight `0` for the interior.
nodes.title: Zero corner weight of the interior off the walk

nodes.summary: A cycle graph has one connected component. A specialization of `SimpleGraph.Preconnected.subsingleton_connectedComponent`.
nodes.title: A cycle graph has one connected component

nodes.summary: The cycle graph on `m + 3` vertices has `m + 3` edges.
nodes.title: Number of edges of a cycle graph

nodes.summary: The cycle graph has nullity (cycle rank) `1`.
nodes.title: Cycle graph has cycle rank one

nodes.summary: If cells `(a, b)` and `(a, b + 1)` have different ray parities, a horizontal step separates them.
nodes.title: Vertical neighbours of different parity are separated by a horizontal step

nodes.summary: The interior of a simple closed walk has pinch count `0`. See also `StatMech.Onsager.WalkCellLocal.pinchCount_interiorCells_eq_zero`.
nodes.title: Pinch count of the ray-parity interior is zero

nodes.summary: The interior of a simple closed walk has no pinch points.
nodes.title: Interior of a simple closed walk has no pinch points

nodes.summary: The vertices of a simple walk are distinct sites.
nodes.title: Vertices of a simple walk are distinct sites

nodes.summary: The `i`-th vertex of the walk as a site of `ℤ²`.
nodes.title: Vertex of a walk as a lattice site

nodes.summary: Each step has `ℓ¹`-length `1`.
nodes.title: Each lattice step has $\ell^1$-length one

nodes.summary: Consecutive vertices of the walk are adjacent in the square lattice.
nodes.title: Consecutive walk vertices are adjacent in the square lattice

nodes.summary: Lattice Jordan curve theorem for a simple closed walk: its complement in the face graph of `ℤ²` has exactly one bounded connected component.
nodes.title: Lattice Jordan curve theorem for simple closed walks

nodes.summary: The planar subgraph of a simple closed walk has nullity `1`.
nodes.title: Subgraph of a simple closed lattice walk has cycle rank one

nodes.title: Simple closed walk as an embedded cycle graph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
